name: Maps - store locator
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Maps - store locator.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Location cards, contact links and directions work without JavaScript. Search matches the configured text; it does not geocode a ZIP or calculate distance. Google Maps requires an enabled, restricted public API key and provider billing/configuration. A failed or unavailable API keeps the native location list.
